deltas.delta: Reth main merged an experimental revmc JIT (paradigmxyz/reth PR 23230, merged 2026-06-11) that compiles hot contracts to native code behind a --jit flag. The nanoreth master Cargo.lock fetched this cycle contains no revmc crate, so the public replicas cannot run that JIT. Whether Hyperliquid's closed hl-node uses any such compiler is not published.

cleared.check: L-1333: the wide fee mulDiv at src/libraries/SwapMath.sol:64-65 (PoolManager pc 22445/22513) run by eth_call through the deployed PoolManager 0x12D4...6B1F against three existing hookless pools (ids 0x10286777..., native and 0x44d6...; 0x3c4a8680..., WHYPE and 0x887c...; 0x4bf2e188..., 0xd4a2... and 0xfc91...), both directions, exact input of -2^236, -2^240, -2^250 and -(2^255-1), price limit two to three ticks away. A driver placed by state override unlocks, reads slot0 and liquidity, swaps, reads them again with the driver's two deltas, and reverts, so nothing settles.
cleared.result: All 24 calls return the same bytes on the official node and on both replicas. For each pool and direction the swap delta is the same for all four amounts, and the three amounts at or above 2^240 have a product (1e6 - fee) times amount of 2^256 or more, so the wide path ran. The swaps consume only what the limit allows: for example 0.0665 native HYPE in for 245,609 units of 0x44d6 in pool 0x10286777, and 0.0103 WHYPE in pool 0x3c4a8680. In 20 of the 24 cases the swap stayed in one step and the delta equals v4math.compute_swap_step to the unit; the other 4 (pool 0x10286777, one for zero, all four amounts) crossed out of the liquidity range, end with liquidity 0 at the limit, and agree across endpoints. The code bounds what a wrong word there could do: amountRemainingLessFee is only compared with amountIn at SwapMath.sol:69 and then discarded; if a wrong word fell below amountIn, the step would take the exhaust branch, consume the whole remaining amount as amountIn plus fee (SwapMath.sol:76-82, Pool.sol:377-380), and the final cast of amountSpecified minus amountSpecifiedRemaining, at least 2^236 in size, to int128 would revert (src/libraries/Pool.sol:452-460, src/libraries/SafeCast.sol:40-43). A wrong word can therefore change no settled amount.

leadResults.answer: Yes, the site is reachable in existing pools with a settleable amount, and it returns the reference words. 24 eth_calls through the deployed PoolManager against three existing hookless pools, exact input from -2^236 to -(2^255-1), gave byte equal answers on the official node and both replicas, the same delta for every amount, and the single-step reference to the unit in 20 cases (the other 4 crossed a range edge and agree across endpoints). The swap moves only what the limit allows, for example 0.0665 HYPE in pool 0x10286777. The wide word only decides the comparison at SwapMath.sol:69; a wrong word below amountIn would make the swap consume the whole amount and revert at the int128 cast at Pool.sol:452-460, so no settled amount can change. Hyperliquid's docs and full docs text say nothing about compiling or caching code per contract or per program counter, and no hl-node release notes are public.

No public source says. The HyperEVM docs and full docs text name only Cancun without blobs and no executor; the official endpoint's error strings ('EVM error: PrecompileError', 'out of gas: gas exhausted during precompiled contract execution') are revm's, which points to revm for eth_call; hl-visor holds no EVM code and hl-node returns HTTP 403. The replicas' lockfile has no revmc crate. Whatever the producer runs, the L-1333 result bounds the wide fee site: a wrong word there can only revert the swap.

Operator level, recorded for reference. Unchanged from cycle 34: alignedQuoteTokenInfo returns HTTP 422 with and without a token, spotMeta (522 tokens) has no treasury field, and for the PoolManager userRole is missing, spot balances are empty, the non-funding ledger is empty and the EVM nonce is 1. No transfer in the PoolManager's name has happened.
